blocks.text: Hollywood actress and humanitarian Angelina Jolie is set to visit the Philippines and attend the 2026 Asean Inclusive Growth Summit, where she will be one of the featured speakers. Mastercard Center for Inclusive Growth, the host of the summit, confirmed this through its social media pages on Friday, Nov. 6. “For more than two decades, Angelina has championed human rights, advocated for refugees and displaced communities, and worked to protect vulnerable populations around the world,” it said of the acclaimed actress. “On Nov. 11, she joins leaders and changemakers in Manila to explore new perspectives on opportunity, inclusion, and building a […]...
